dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, have you been to Sukhothai? I want one more place for my list.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, hæv juː bɪn tə ˌsuːkoʊˈtaɪ? aɪ ˈwɑːnt ˈwʌn ˈmɔːr ˈpleɪs fər maɪ ˈlɪst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. I've been there twice.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæv. aɪv bɪn ˈðɛr ˈtwaɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I went there last year with my class. We explored the old city by bike.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɛnt ˈðɛr ˈlæst ˈjɪr wɪð maɪ ˈklæs. wiː ɪkˈsplɔːrd ði ˈoʊld ˈsɪti baɪ ˈbaɪk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That sounds fun! Was it far?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈfʌn! wʌz ɪt ˈfɑːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. The journey took about seven hours by bus.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə ˈdʒɜːrni ˈtʊk əˈbaʊt ˈsɛvən ˈaʊərz baɪ ˈbʌs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I had a guidebook in English. It was very useful.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈɡaɪdbʊk ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ. ɪt wʌz ˈvɛri ˈjuːsfəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The view of the old temples at sunset. It was a memorable trip!
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈvjuː əv ði ˈoʊld ˈtɛmpəlz ət ˈsʌnsɛt. ɪt wʌz ə ˈmɛmərəbəl ˈtrɪp!
